package.name: wojtek_slam
package.description:
RGB-D SLAM for wojtek: RTAB-Map over the D435 streams and the leg odometry. Owns the map->odom edge and the map products (3D cloud, 2D occupancy grid, the database a session leaves behind).
Launch plus configuration only: it composes the third-party rtabmap nodes (rgbd_sync, rtabmap) around this package's settings, the way wojtek_perception_bringup composes the camera driver. The odometry it builds on is wojtek_odometry's; the streams are the camera bringup's.
